subject: Mobile Development
subcategory: Famous Apps That Changed the World
title: Shopify: Everyone Gets a Store
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Shopify: Everyone Gets a Store.

hook.text: A snowboard shop owner couldn't find good e-commerce software, so he built his own.

buildup.text: Shopify lets anyone create an online store without knowing how to code.

discovery.text: Over four million stores run on Shopify, processing hundreds of billions in sales.

twist.text: Shopify's mobile app lets merchants run entire businesses from their phone while on the go.

climax.text: Shopify democratized e-commerce the way WordPress democratized websites.

punchline.text: A snowboard shop became the backbone of online retail.

quiz.question: How many stores run on Shopify?
